critical_code_review_comments: AnalyticsPanel: metric tiles + analytics-regime-breakdown are conditionally hidden when closed_trades==0 (empty state shown instead). Acceptable design but means data-testid=analytics-regime-breakdown is absent on a fresh deploy until at least one round-trip closes — verified working once SELL trades exist.
Analytics endpoint correctly excludes mongo _id, uses isoformat string comparison for time windows (works because timestamps stored as ISO strings, consistent ordering).

Loss rate is derived from win_rate_pct in compute_performance via len(losses)/n, but trades with pnl==0 (breakeven) are excluded from both wins and losses — could under-report rate if breakeven trades occur. Not a blocker for Phase A.
server.py is 695 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting analytics + backtest routes into routers in Phase B.
